notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
You control at least eight other mana-producing lands, three of which can tap to produce at least {G}.
description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland, adding {G} if possible, or one mana of any other type otherwise.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other mana-producing lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more other mana-producing lands, this combo will net infinite mana of colors those lands can produce.
